text.en: When you activate this card, you can also Tribute 1 Plant monster; take 2 "Rikka" monsters from your Deck with the same Level, but different names, add 1 of them to your hand and send the other to the GY, also if you Tributed a monster at activation, your opponent cannot target "Rikka" monsters you control with card effects this turn. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Plant Xyz Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Rikka June Moon" per turn.
